verdict.rationale: Chroma's marketing page lists point-in-time-recovery alongside BYOC and replication. Chroma Cloud offers copy-on-write collection forking for dataset versioning, which works like a snapshot, and a community user corroborates the forking. No evidence documents an explicit backup or snapshot workflow, nor how to restore a collection from a fork or a recovery point. Missing for 10: documented snapshot/backup creation for collections, a restore procedure from a snapshot or PITR point, coverage for self-hosted/OSS deployments, and hands-on corroboration of backup/restore.
